LanguageData.JLX_LinkDesc: Link a laser cannon or mining laser to this console (up to {0}, within {1} tiles). While a colonist mans the console, every linked laser counts as manned.
LanguageData.JLX_UnlinkDesc: Disconnect every laser from this console.
LanguageData.JLX_TooFar: Too far: lasers must be within {0} tiles of the console.
LanguageData.JLX_TooMany: A console can run at most {0} lasers.
LanguageData.JLX_InspectNoPower: No power: linked lasers aren't manned.
LanguageData.JLX_InspectManned: Manned by {0}: linked lasers are manned.
LanguageData.JLX_CannotManViolent: Cannot man: {0} is incapable of violence
LanguageData.JLX_CannotManNoPower: Cannot man: the console has no power
LanguageData.JLX_CannotManNoPath: Cannot man: no path, or someone else is using it
